response: Saved Views is available today, giving you a faster way to organize and revisit the exact filters, sorts, and groupings you rely on most. Instead of rebuilding the same list configuration every time you open a project, you can now save it once and return to it with a single click. This feature is included in all paid plans, so every team already subscribed gets access at no extra cost. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from sprint boards to overdue tasks to client-specific dashboards, giving you plenty of room to organize work exactly how you think about it. Views can also be shared with your team, so teammates see the same setup you do without recreating filters or explaining your process in a meeting. Whether you're tracking priorities across departments or keeping a personal list of what matters most this week, Saved Views helps everyone stay aligned and focused. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
